personality.description: This person is imaginative and curious, often drawn to fresh ideas, unusual angles, and spontaneous changes in plans. In daily habits, they tend to start things energetically, shift quickly between interests, and keep a flexible approach, though they may be disorganized and sometimes overlook details or deadlines. When faced with moral dilemmas, they usually try to understand multiple perspectives and look for creative compromises, but will firmly defend their own principles if they feel strongly about an issue. In group discussions, they speak easily and enthusiastically, contribute many ideas, and are socially engaging, while remaining willing to cooperate without always yielding their own viewpoint.
traits: has achieved positions of leadership through exceptional performance and abilities
focuses on fostering positive relationships and teamwork
cares a lot about what others think of them
takes input from others on how tasks should be accomplished
is quick to find common ground between other people's ideas and their own
